question.text: Vectors <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></math> are perpendicular to each other when <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>b</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn></math>, the ratio of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi></math> to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>b</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> is _____.

solution.text:
Dot product of two perpendicular vectors will be zero. Therefore,

ai^+bj^+k^·2i^-3j^+4k^=0

⇒2a-3b+4=0   ...Eq(1)

As given in the question,

3a+2b=7   ...Eq(2)

From both equations, we get a=1 & b=2

Then, 

ab=x2⇒x=2ab=2×12

⇒  x=1
